test_title: PYST 47: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 15 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. All M are N, 

II. Some X are M.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some X are not N.

II. Some N are not M.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/804118155b1a75985751af4e647eb272b306659a228f20965b71c4013017ebe3.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some X are not N → Does not Follow (As, all M are N and some X are M. So, as no direct negative or cross relation is given between X and N therefore, it is definitely false)

II. Some N are not M → Does not Follow (As, all M are N and some X are M. So, as no direct negative or cross relation is given between M and N therefore, it is definitely false)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Neither conclusion follows**"
